ExamDto.description: Data Transfer Object representing the official structure of the exam (e.g., from an edital).

examDate.description: The scheduled date for the exam. Must be in the future.

generalKnowledgeSubjects.description: List of subjects evaluated in the general knowledge section.

generalKnowledgeTotalScore.description: The total score available in the general knowledge section.

name.description: The official name of the exam.

specificKnowledgeAxes.description: List of thematic axes, which group specific knowledge subjects and define their weights.

GaConfigDto.description: Configuration settings for the Genetic Algorithm.

numGenerations.description: The number of evolutionary cycles the algorithm will run. Higher yields better results but takes longer.

populationSize.description: The number of potential solutions evolving per generation.

totalStudyDays.description: The target number of study days to allocate across all subjects.

OptimizationRequest.description: The main request payload for generating an optimized study plan.

exam.description: The structure and rules of the exam.

gaConfig.description: Configuration parameters for the underlying Genetic Algorithm engine.

studentProfile.description: The personal profile of the student, including availability and knowledge gaps.

OptimizationResultDto.description: The strategic result generated by the Genetic Algorithm.

executionTimeMillis.description: The total execution time of the optimization algorithm in milliseconds.

fitness.description: The final calculated fitness score of the best individual.

generationsRun.description: The number of evolutionary generations processed before finding this solution.

plan.description: The allocated study days for each subject.

PlannerResponseDto.description: The comprehensive response containing both the strategic and tactical study plans.

message.description: A status message summarizing the generation outcome.

optimizationResult.description: The strategic output from the Genetic Algorithm (e.g., total days per subject).

scheduleResult.description: The tactical, day-by-day study schedule based on the optimization result.

ScheduleResultDto.description: The tactical, day-by-day scheduling result based on the optimized plan and student availability.

availableHours.description: The total number of hours the student has available before the exam.

requiredHours.description: The total number of hours required to complete the ideal study plan.

schedule.description: A mapping of specific dates to a list of study blocks scheduled for that day.

status.description: An indicator of whether the ideal plan was fully scheduled, or if there was a time deficit/surplus.

StudentProfileDto.description: Data Transfer Object representing the student's personal constraints and knowledge state.

knowledgeGaps.description: A mapping of subject names to the student's self-assessed knowledge gap on a 1.0 (very strong) to 5.0 (very weak) scale.

state.description: The psychological, physical, and emotional state of the student.

weeklyAvailability.description: A mapping of the days of the week to the number of hours the student is available to study on that day.

StudentStateDto.description: Data Transfer Object representing the student's psychological, physical, and emotional state.

fatigueLevel.description: Fatigue level on a 1.0 (very low) to 5.0 (very high) scale.

motivationLevel.description: Motivation level on a 1.0 (very low) to 5.0 (very high) scale.

stressLevel.description: Stress level on a 1.0 (very low) to 5.0 (very high) scale.

StudyBlockDto.description: Represents a distinct, contiguous block of study time allocated to a specific subject.

hours.description: The number of hours allocated to this block.

subjectName.description: The name of the subject to study in this block.

StudyPlanDto.description: The core output of the Genetic Algorithm, representing the optimal distribution of study days across subjects.

daysPerSubject.description: A mapping where keys are subject names and values are the optimal number of days to study them.

SubjectDto.description: Data Transfer Object for a specific study subject within an exam.

cognitiveLoad.description: An intrinsic, objective difficulty score for this subject (1=Very Easy, 5=Extremely Difficult), used for load balancing.

questionCount.description: The number of questions expected for this subject on the exam.

ThematicAxisDto.description: Data Transfer Object grouping related specific knowledge subjects into an axis with a shared weight.

id.description: A unique identifier for the thematic axis.

name.description: A descriptive name for the axis.

subjects.description: The list of subjects belonging to this thematic axis.

weight.description: The multiplier weight applied to all questions within this axis.

info.description: A stateless REST API that uses Genetic Algorithms to orchestrate an optimized and mathematically superior study plan. Built with Spring Boot.
info.title: Dynamic Study Planner API

post.description: Runs a Genetic Algorithm to find the optimal allocation of study days, then generates a day-by-day tactical schedule.

200.description: Successfully generated the optimized study plan.

400.description: Bad Request. Validation failed for the input payload.

408.description: Request Timeout. The algorithm took too long to compute.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity. The business logic failed (e.g., impossible constraints).

500.description: Internal Server Error. An unexpected exception occurred.

tags.description: Endpoints for generating computationally optimized study plans using AI.
tags.name: Study Plan Optimizer
